name: NetHunt CRM
description_en:
NetHunt CRM is a product in the CRM category. Its directory profile covers Advanced Automation, Real-time Data Sync, Omnichannel Customer Engagement, Predictive Analytics, Dedicated Phone Line Integration, IoT Integration, Customer Segmentation, Opportunity Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Sales Force Automation, Customization, Territory Management, Reporting (Analytics), Order Management, Collaboration Tools, Lead Management, Quotes (Proposals). These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $24.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: combine conditions and actions in multi-step automated processes; propagate changes between connected data sources; coordinate customer interactions across communication channels; use historical information to estimate future outcomes; connect telephone services to the operational workflow; connect supported device data to software workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
NetHunt CRM 属于客户关系管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括进阶自动化、实时数据同步、多渠道客户互动、预测分析、专用电话线路集成、物联网集成、客户分群、销售机会管理。

资料还列出销售流程自动化、自定义设置、销售区域管理、报表与分析、订单管理、协作工具、潜在客户管理、报价与方案。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $24.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：组合条件和动作处理多步骤自动流程；在已连接的数据源之间同步变更；协调不同沟通渠道中的客户互动；根据历史信息估计后续结果；将电话服务接入业务工作流；将受支持设备的数据接入软件流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
